subtitulo: Web platform for orchestrating container-based SDN networks
descripcion: Design and development of a full-stack platform for the automated deployment and orchestration of virtualized network topologies on Containerlab and Docker.
Implementation of hybrid persistence (MySQL for administrative management and declarative YAML files as Single Source of Truth - SSOT).
Asynchronous API built with FastAPI, featuring real-time telemetry streaming and log monitoring via WebSockets.
Reactive frontend built with React and Tailwind CSS, featuring OAuth 2.0 (Google Auth) integration, an interactive network topology viewer, and real-time metrics monitoring.

subtitulo: Official mobile app for the Santa María la Real de Huelgas Monastery
descripcion: Development of a native Android mobile app aimed at heritage promotion and an immersive visit experience for the monastery in Valladolid.
Immersive virtual tour featuring 360° panoramic views, dynamic sector-based interactive map, multimedia gallery, and educational mini-games.
Tour booking and inquiry feature with quick access to direct calling and pre-configured email.
Modular MVVM architecture to decouple business logic from the UI, with Firebase cloud integration.
